lead_headline: Zero new restaurant leads overnight as weekend data settles — active tracker holds at 172 (95 openings, 77 closures) with no movement since Friday

restaurant.blurb: No new leads today — tracker flat at 172 active (95 openings, 77 closures). Weekend additions included Lost Coffee's Arvada debut and Monarch's wood-fired pizza launch inside Urban Cowboy Public House.

liquor.blurb: Nineteen days without a pulse — Colorado's liquor license database remains completely frozen since April 30's renewal spike with zero applications, zero status changes, zero activity across all license classes statewide. The blackout now spans nearly three weeks as May barrels toward a perfect zero close with no official explanation, no timeline, no departmental acknowledgment of the shutdown. System dead quiet as industry waits in the dark.

reputation.blurb: 2 mentions yesterday — Instagram Colfax BRT discussion plus RiNo ArtPark residency announcement — holds the 7-day total at 44 across 11 sources, down 17% from prior week's 53. Instagram leads at 11 mentions (25% share), followed by Facebook and Denver Post tied at 10 each. Google News RSS continues dominance at 91% of discoveries (40 of 44). Monthly total 198 as week-over-week decline steepens heading into Tuesday.

subscriptions.blurb: Net flat yesterday (0 new, 0 canceled) leaves MTD at +21 (+1.2/day) with 90-day net at +134. The weekend stall follows Friday's +5 surge as acquisition dries up entirely — last two days delivered zero new subs versus prior five-day stretch averaging 3.4 daily. The 7-day window closes at +10 (17 new, 7 canceled), up from prior period's +6 but masking the recent freeze: last 48 hours show complete inactivity after mid-week momentum delivered +9 across three days.
